seoTitle: Moore Public Schools Calendar 2027–28 | Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Moore Public Schools starts Aug. 12, 2027, and ends May 19, 2028. See breaks, conference days, the Jan. 4 return after Winter Break, official PDF, and ICS.
heroSummary: Moore Public Schools begins the 2027–28 school year on Thursday, Aug. 12, 2027, and the last day for students is Friday, May 19, 2028. Thanksgiving Break runs Nov. 22–26, Winter Break runs Dec. 20–31, and Spring Break runs March 13–17. Students are also out Monday, Jan. 3, for Record Day, so classes resume Tuesday, Jan. 4.

calendarNotes: Teachers report August 9 and students report August 12. The PDF lists 175 instructional days and seven professional days; its 182 total combines those categories rather than counting 182 student days. September 20 is an In-service day with no school. October 13 is a no-school Parent/Teacher Conference day followed by Fall Break October 14–15. Winter Break ends December 31, January 3 is Record Day, and students return January 4. February 14 is labeled TNT Day and shaded as a teacher professional day; MPS does not explain what TNT stands for. March 10 is another no-school conference day immediately before Spring Break. The last student day is May 19, followed by Record Day May 22. The October month grid misprints 29 where the calendar sequence and weekday alignment require 19; no listed event depends on that cell.

customSections.label: Why the MPS Calendar Shows 182 Days
customSections.content: The 182 shown on the MPS calendar does not mean students attend school for 182 days. It combines 175 instructional days with seven professional days.

table.footnote: Oct. 13 is a no-school day for students. March 10 is shaded as a Teacher Professional Day and is included in the second semester's three professional days. May 22 is a Record Day after the last student day and is not part of the printed 182-day total.

customSections.label: What Changes From MPS 2026–27?
customSections.content: The approved calendars keep the same 83/92 instructional split, seven professional days, and 182 combined total. Several major dates fall earlier in 2027–28, and the last student day moves from May 21 to May 19.

customSections.label: How Weather Can Change the Moore Calendar
customSections.content: Oklahoma requires students to complete 1,086 instructional hours. MPS checks its banked minutes before deciding whether missed time must be made up. ParentSquare is the district's primary notification source, and MPS aims to announce cancellations by 6 a.m.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the Moore 2027–28 calendar BOE approved?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official MPS 2027–28 PDF is labeled BOE approved December 8, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Moore students return after Winter Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ends Friday, December 31, but Monday, January 3, is Record Day. Students return Tuesday, January 4, based on the published break and Record Day sequence.

calendarFaqs.q: What is TNT Day on the Moore 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: February 14 is labeled TNT Day and shaded as a teacher professional day, so students are out. MPS does not explain what TNT stands for, so we keep the district's label rather than guessing.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the October 2027 calendar grid show 29 after October 18?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF appears to misprint 29 where Oct. 19 should be. No holiday, break, or professional day is tied to that cell, so the typo does not change any of the school dates listed here.
